title: V21 Exness 22-month portfolio census (selected near-miss candidates)
trade_data: Exness historical BTCUSD and ETHUSD 2025-01 through 2026-10; Bid/Ask
selection: Top 50 individual near misses sorted by profitable months; 48 unique monthly curves after deduplication rounding to 0.01bp
selection_caveat: Strong data-snooping; counts are within this chosen subset, not exhaustive over all 25,622 profitable-month eligible single variants
month_assignment: Month trade closes; all 22 months require nonzero trading and strictly positive modeled PnL
aggregation: Equal notional weighting across independently executable strategies; monthly portfolio bp is arithmetic mean of monthly single-strategy bp
cost_model: Historical Exness Bid/Ask spread + assumed 1bp slippage per side; no overnight swap, separate commission, margin, liquidation or market impact
